source_refs.note: 2. String Theory: a main subheading of 12.11 The theories about the forces between the masses of particles, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 275-276.

blocks.text: String Theory is an advanced concept in theoretical physics proposing that the fundamental particles of the universe, instead of being point-like, are actually tiny vibrating strings. These strings can be open or closed loops, and their vibrations determine the properties of particles, including mass and force. String Theory framework, offering a potential theory of everything, still remains unproved experimentally.
